learnings: API errors and tool failures should be clearly distinguished from security findings - they indicate infrastructure issues, not package risks
When one model has complete coverage and finds no issues, while others have tool failures, the complete report should be weighted more heavily
Advisory reports should be clearly marked and excluded from voting tallies to avoid confusion about disagreement
Standard AUR packaging patterns (pinned sources with checksums, informational install scripts, no top-level code execution) are reliable indicators of safe packages
